name: project-tree
description: Worktrees for a folder of git repos: one worktree per repo on the same branch, all made at once, so parallel sessions each get their own copy of the whole project.

interface.shortDescription: Worktrees across a folder of git repos
interface.longDescription: Start Codex in a project tree with `project-tree codex <name>`: every repo becomes a git worktree on that branch, and Codex can commit in each.
